deduction_set.house-single: Only candidate in a row/column/zone; remove peers.
deduction_set.shared-conflict: A house must contain one capy; a cell conflicting with every candidate of that house is excluded. Covers intersections and common adjacency; no branching.

independent_oracle: Python exhaustively enumerates every column permutation with separate adjacency, rock and zone constraints. Separate JavaScript row DFS cross-checks every source and actual date/eligibility outputs; it checks every logical deduction against the unique solution.
